A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 31-page paper, including references and appendices. Pages 2–31 have identical extracted text and rendered content. Page 1 differs only in date and version metadata.

before.justification: v1 reports original MoS benchmark results, router ablations, latency measurements, and generation/editing examples in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original MoS experiments and outcomes, including the benchmark scores in Table 5 and analyses in Appendix B.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithms 1–2 retain the same dual-tower architecture, token-specific top-k router, epsilon-greedy training, and generation/editing procedures.

E1.justification: Training-data coverage and evaluation tasks are unchanged, including MJHQ, GenEval, DPG, WISE, oneIG, ImgEdit, and GEdit. No test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in the corresponding quantitative and qualitative comparisons. Table 5 retains Qwen-Image, SANA-1.5, FLUX.1[Dev], and Bagel; appendix comparator sets are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The model configurations, training schedules, resolutions, evaluation metrics, and GPT-4o-based editing evaluation remain identical. Appendix B.6 retains the same inference-setting experiments.

E4.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix B retain the same routing, normalization, sparsity, scaling, editing-context, inference-strategy, and router-visualization analyses.

E5.justification: Statistical and uncertainty reporting is identical throughout both PDFs. No repeated-run, seed, interval, error-bar, or significance-reporting information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 5 reports MoS-L scores of 0.90 on GenEval, 87.01 on DPG, 7.86 on GEdit, and 4.33 on ImgEdit in both versions.

T1.justification: The objective and routing definitions in Equations 1–4 are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about adaptive multimodal fusion, asymmetric towers, efficiency, and performance relative to larger models.

C2.justification: Results interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning early fusion, preference alignment, efficiency, explainability, and small-object artifacts.

D1.justification: Section 3.5 and Appendix A retain identical training costs, optimizer settings, routing hyperparameters, hardware, precision, and implementation details. Code/data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the bibliography, and the positioning relative to attention-based fusion, MoT, and dynamic neural networks are identical. No cited works are added or removed.

P1.justification: The displayed date changes from November 18, 2025 to March 17, 2026. The arXiv stamp updates its version and date, and its hyperlink points to v2. All substantive wording and document structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–17, Tables 1–11, algorithm displays, captions, and their placement are unchanged. Pages 2–31 render identically; page 1 retains the same layout apart from the metadata text updates.

improvement.justification: Only date/version metadata and the associated arXiv hyperlink change. The methods, empirical evidence, explanations, limitations, reproducibility details, and substantive presentation remain identical, including the appendices. These administrative updates produce no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
